bug: Tier boundaries are exclusive (quantity > minimum); the spec makes them inclusive, so 10 and 50 units miss their discounts.
issue: CHK-1403: ordering exactly 10 (or exactly 50) units of an item doesn't get the bulk discount.
impossibility: SPEC.md puts 49 units in the 10-to-49 tier (10% off): 49 x 4.50 = 220.50. The mutated assertion expects 196.00 (the 20% tier), so every implementation that follows the spec fails it. Moving the 20% boundary down to 49 passes every test but violates the spec's table for every price at 49 units.
